topics.title: Write about an accident you had
guiding_questions: When and where did it happen?
What did you learn from this accident?
topics.sample_essay: Last year, I had a bike accident near my house. I was riding my bike very fast when a car suddenly came out of a side street. I tried to stop but I fell off my bike and hurt my knee. My friend Ali was with me and he helped me walk home. I learned that I should always be careful when riding my bike. Now, I always wear my helmet and I don't ride too fast.
